text:
kayla: throwing up a quick follow-up from hallway chat: we need a compact design for tenant-scoped automatic fallback that minimizes oscillation and keeps accounting simple.
diego: agree. main tension is speed (local decisions) vs global cost caps.
rahul: proposal: decision-plane at edge handles per-request fast heuristics; control-plane pushes policy + hard caps + sim runs.
sue: what heuristics? p95 over last 20s, queue depth, active-kv-hit-rate, and a quality-hook that flags regressions. also an operator override channel.
kayla: fallback candidates should be deterministic and safe: prefer same-model lower-precision -> smaller-quantized sibling -> cached response. avoid switching across families unless explicit.
diego: make fallbacks idempotent. also attach a monotonic fallback-version so retries don't flip-flop.
rahul: oscillation control: per-tenant cooldown (e.g., 30s) + token-leaky-bucket for number of fallbacks allowed per minute. plus simple hysteresis window (require p95>threshold for X seconds).
sue: session affinity: many customers need KV continuity. prefer local co-located variants; if unavailable, return cached last-good with a header warning.
kayla: telemetry: structured reason codes in logs: capacity, latency_spike, quality_regression, operator_action, probe_timeout. include tenant_id, route, model_version, and estimated token-delta.
diego: API sketch (very short):
```
route=/v1/chat/generate
safepath.enabled=true
safepath.hysteresis_ms=1500
safepath.fallbacks=["rwi-8q","rwi-6b-q","cached_short"]
safepath.cooldown_s=30
```
rahul: runtime note: keep per-tenant state limited. store only N hot tenants in local LRU (N configurable by deploy). cold tenants fall back to default policy from control-plane.
sue: cache warmup strategy: async prefix-KV sync towards fallback instance when system has spare warmup budget; otherwise skip warmup and let fallback serve stateless. avoid blocking main request.
kayla: rollout plan: 1) observability-only for 1 region; 2) opt-in internal tenant for 48h; 3) expand to small external cohort. measure fallback frequency, latency delta, and cost change.
diego: ops playbook: pager if fallback rate >1.5% sustained for 15m OR >1000 fallbacks in 10m. also page for any quality_regression events >5 in 1h.
rahul: DSL constraints: keep it tiny. conditions limited to sliding-window signals; actions limited to route-to, hedge-percent, fallback-order, and no-op. evaluate in O(1).
sue: tests: deterministic sim for a variety of bursts, integration test for affinity-preserving fallback, chaos test with full-region capacity loss.
kayla: implementation phasing: 1) wire telemetry + reasons; 2) local decision loop + LRU tenant store; 3) control-plane caps + policy push; 4) opt-in rollout.
ops-bot: deploy planned: hedge-edge-v0.1 -> canary 2026-05-03T09:00:00Z :rocket:
diego: please include cost-accounting per-event (tokens delta) in telemetry so finance can run impact sims.
rahul: will add RFC with API examples, DSL, sim harness, and eviction semantics.
sue: +1 to include hysteresis unit tests and a short note on audit logs retention for enterprise tenants.
kayla: thanks all  I'll write the RFC and link it here when done :thumbsup:
